name: Firecrawl
summary: Scrape and crawl sites to markdown.
description: Firecrawl's hosted server scrapes pages, crawls sites and extracts structured data.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (www.firecrawl.dev) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
